messages:
mira: FYI I just found that analytics-collector role can now PUT to s3://redwood-raw-collect after the RBAC aggregate PR. Not sure which change expanded permissions.
sam: thanks - can you paste the diff or policy snippet?
mira: here's the statement I see in IAM policy: ```{ "Effect":"Allow","Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-raw-collect/*" }``` Only expected GetObject.
jordan: ugh. Was there a role mapping change earlier? @kai did the role-aggregation merge yesterday?
kai: I merged #8421, it changed role:analytics-collector -> group:ingest-workers + role:legacy-collector. I didn't intend to add write perms. Will rollback in a sec.
mira: creating incident PRIV-DRIFT-210150 and adding temporary deny rule on bucket. inc-bot: Incident PRIV-DRIFT-210150 opened (sev:high).
inc-bot: Action required: apply deny s3:PutObject for role analytics-collector across accounts. See runbook: /runbooks/rbac-privilege-drift.
sam: run this to apply deny - `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name analytics-collector --policy-name deny-put-temp --policy-document file://deny.json`
olivia: also enable CloudTrail lookup for PutObject events and KMS Decrypt in case data was modified. I'm pulling logs now.
jordan: quick audit query I ran: `SELECT count(*) FROM s3_access WHERE action='PutObject' AND bucket='redwood-raw-collect' AND eventTime >= '2026-03-19T00:00:00Z'` -> 3 events from ingest-worker nodes.
mira: those 3 uploads look like small heartbeat files (1KB) not user data, but we should be safe. olivia, can you verify KMS CMK access logs?
olivia: CMK logs show no Decrypt calls tied to those uploads, so contents weren't encrypted with CMK that would expose secrets.
kai: rolling back the merge now, will open a new PR with explicit least-priv policy and add unit tests for policy linting.
sam: can we add an automated CI check that rejects policies with PutObject on raw buckets unless flagged?
jordan: yes - I'll add a policy-scan rule. For now leave deny in place until new PR is in prod. action items: kai rollback, sam add rule, olivia finish log evidence, mira coordinate customer comms if needed.
mira: assigned. tagging @security-oncall for review and key rotation decision.
security-oncall: saw logs, agree no key rotation yet. keep deny and monitor 24h, if no other anomalies close incident.
mira: thanks. closing loop in 24h unless new evidence. :thumbsup:
